project_info.theme: melancholic black-and-white portrait with understated watch styling

main_subject.description: A handsome adult man matching the required approved adult non-public-figure identity reference, with naturally textured dark hair, light facial stubble, and a contemplative expression.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a professional 3:4 black-and-white portrait of a handsome adult man matching the required approved adult non-public-figure identity reference. Frame his upper body at a narrow 30-degree angle as he looks down and rests one hand gently over his chest near the heart. Use very soft subdued side light, a deep-black studio background, restrained highlights, controlled shadows, realistic wool and skin texture, subtle monochrome grain, and no text or logos.
